Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 4

“Here are heroes, great archers, equal in battle to Bhima and Arjuna — Yuyudhana, Virata, and the great chariot-warrior Drupada.”

Duryodhana begins listing the Pandava side's warriors — a roll call meant to sound impressive, but really betraying his own nervousness at the scale of the opposition.
